verdict.rationale: Bland can be driven without its UI. An official CLI manages the whole account from the terminal, including making calls and building and testing pathways (bland-docs-12, bland-probe-4). Pathways can also be created programmatically via API (bland-docs-1), and batch calls, post-call webhooks and triggers support automated flows (bland-docs-6, bland-docs-5, bland-docs-41). missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs or examples, documented non-interactive auth for CI runners, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.
